description: This file contains functions for computing project task schedules and timelines based on task data, including recursive project computations and date calculations, within the context of the OpenERP (Odoo) framework.

methods.name: _compute_tasks
methods.description: Calculates task start and end dates based on task dependencies, user assignments, and project timelines.

methods.name: _compute_project
methods.description: Recursively computes tasks and last date for a project and its subprojects.

methods.name: _project_compute
methods.description: Initializes project data and triggers the recursive project computation.
